minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, March 15, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:04 AM on Wednesday, March 15, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Scott Snider, Lorraine Missick, Jenny
  Jolly, Edward Padgett and Rafaela Giles.

  Members Absent: Bette Donovan

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.

  Guest Present: None.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, February 15,
  2023, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Ken Domer, City Manager

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Grab-n-Go Meals: Meals were distributed to an increased average of 155
  participants per week in February.

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 40 participants per week in
  February.

  Meals on Wheels: February numbers will be available at the April 19, 2023 meeting.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of January was
  $3218.41. The average attendance for January was 70 players per week. The total
  balance for February was $3149.41. $150 cash reserved to pay special St. Patrick’s
  Day game. The average attendance in February was 51.

5. Account Balance: $8,068.59.

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: Classes going well. Registration will be June 2.

8. Aging Next: Combined January and February total number of La Verne residents
  served was 13 (via Joslyn Center and Aging Next office).

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Meeting with a roofer for the leak in the back area of the
  Community Center. Veterans Hall roof is fixed and bathrooms are fixed for leaks.

10. Outstanding Older American: Voted on the Outstanding Older American
  Recognition.

11. Upcoming Events:
  - Thursday, March 16th – St. Patrick’s Line Dancing Party, 10:00 AM
  - Friday, March 17th – Senior Seminar: Medicare 101 – HRBC Insurance,
  9:30 AM
  - Friday, March 17th – Excursion: Luck of the Irish Musical and Luncheon,
  10:15 AM
  - Wednesday, March 22nd – Excursion: Descanso Gardens, 9:30 AM
  - Saturday, April 1st – Egg-Cellent Adventure – Heritage Park, 9:00 AM
  - Friday, April 5th – Senior Seminar: Doc-Talk – Optum, 9:30 AM
  - Friday, April 7th – Excursion: Nethercutt Collection with lunch at the Tam
  O’Shanter Inn, 9:30 AM
  - Monday, April 10th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM

12. Public Comments: Hillcrest Dining Room is now open to the public.

13. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:30 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, April 19th at 10:00 AM.
